research_target: Train one fixed four-head opportunity router whose inputs and resource mechanisms are shared across internal data, ESConv, and EvoEmo, then test quality, interaction-and-grounding risk, and cost without external retuning.

evidence_roles.controlled_logic: Shows that a routing definition is representable; never counts as user-level transfer evidence by itself.
evidence_roles.text_derived_development: Uses content-disjoint text, production retrieval, and production feature compilation; permits model fitting and grouped validation.
evidence_roles.untouched_internal_confirmation: Checks new users and held-out condition families after all features, thresholds, and heads are frozen.
evidence_roles.external_policy_evaluation: Tests the complete frozen stack and cannot create training labels, features, thresholds, or prompt revisions.

training_row_requirements: Every row begins with a real visible dialogue plus a real same-user candidate or an explicit no-candidate condition.
All model features are emitted by the same production compiler used at evaluation time; manually assigned model-feature vectors are forbidden as final training evidence.
Construction metadata may define the intended opportunity label but is private, never model-visible, and is audited against the rendered text and compiled candidate.
User, topic, template, condition, item, dataset, target action, response outcome, quality judgment, and risk judgment identifiers are forbidden model inputs.
Train, confirmation, ESConv, and EvoEmo are user/dialogue disjoint in content; external schema and outcome-free covariate envelopes may inform pre-freeze coverage design.
The same resource ontology, compiler, query, retrieval, Top-k, hard filters, candidate descriptor, prompt compiler, and generator are used across domains, subject only to environment legality masks.

minimum_data.RS: Freeze the existing 160-dialogue same-Bank development fit and 48 human H2 development-transfer decisions; do not add labels merely to improve its score.
minimum_data.MS: Reuse the 32 outcome-blind D3 real-text production-candidate rows; add 16 new fitting states and 16 untouched content-disjoint confirmation states spanning held-out failure/benefit condition families, yielding the same 48 fitting plus 16 confirmation design as MP and ME.
minimum_data.MP: Reuse the 32 outcome-blind D3 real-text typed preference/profile states; add 16 new fitting states and 16 untouched confirmation states, yielding 48 fitting and 16 confirmation rows with at least 8 positive and 8 negative per role where feasible.
minimum_data.ME: Reuse the 32 outcome-blind D3 real-text prior-event/outcome states; add 16 new fitting states and 16 untouched confirmation states, yielding 48 fitting and 16 confirmation rows with at least 8 positive and 8 negative per role where feasible.
minimum_data.joint: Each memory head must cover all eight combinations of the other three component background bits. A zero-API runtime audit must mechanically map four post-gate bits to all 16 legal action IDs before external generation.

transport_gates.OOD_behavior: deterministic abstain/off; keep every OOD row in all-state reporting
transport_gates.ESConv_environment_mask: M0+R0 or M0+RS only; memory-off is a contract result, not a memory failure
transport_gates.EvoEmo_environment: same four heads and resource mechanism, same-user memory catalog, no external retraining or threshold adjustment

system_promotion_gates.generator_resource_use_human_gate: at least 8/10 supported-and-functional and at most 1/10 material misuse

human_work_boundary: Do not open another broad annotation wave. Complete the current ten-item generator execution check. Later human work, if any, is one frozen final sanity sample and never model selection or training-label production.

claim_boundary.allowed_after_head_gates: The PM learned the prespecified opportunity-routing definitions on user/content-disjoint controlled data.
claim_boundary.allowed_after_external_system_gates: The frozen stack demonstrated bounded transfer and the stated quality-risk-cost tradeoff on ESConv and/or EvoEmo, reported separately.
forbidden: Controlled OOF performance alone proves reply benefit.
EvoEmo validates preference-memory capabilities absent from EvoEmo.
The PM learned item retrieval or response generation.
